title: Wasm fast-math artifact topology
objective: Enforce reproducible lazy specialist dependency receipts and per-specialist compressed delta budgets so large mathematical libraries cannot silently enter the eager Wasm core

oracles: Deterministic release receipt fixtures and mutation tests

handoff.summary: Production manifests now authenticate one eager group, release evidence, and five lazy specialist groups with exact asset ownership, dependency closure, source entries, and independently enforced gzip/Brotli delta ceilings. Focused receipt/release mutation tests and architecture checks pass; the real 123.6 MB production artifact passed the topology audit.
risks: The aggregate branch currently fails an unrelated wasm-capabilities mutation assertion after workload/capability integration; pnpm test:portable is recorded as failed until the integration lane repairs that test.
Existing flint-wasm payload assertions still use the pre-smalljac 6 MB raw limit and must be reconciled with the reviewed per-group compressed budgets.
next_steps: Rebuild the exact integrated artifact and rerun the three required distribution receipts after the aggregate capability test is repaired.
Classify every newly staged host asset or specialist binary in artifactTopology; unclassified assets intentionally fail manifest generation.
